protocol.trajectory: one naive note moves linearly from normalized x=1.0 to x=0.0; only duration varies across candidates
protocol.position_rule: x(t) = 1 - t / duration, clamped to [0,1]; Gaussian drive uses only current x at each inherited dt tick
protocol.meaningful_mbon_response: MBON05 max voltage exceeds the frozen action threshold in at least three adjacent position bins and is nonzero; three 0.05 bins span at least 0.10 normalized position
protocol.naive_baseline_gate: not action everywhere means at least one position bin has MBON05 max voltage above the frozen action threshold
protocol.deterministic_replay: for each duration, run the identical input twice from fresh resting state and require exact equality of per-tick position/MBON trace, KC spike events/counts, position map and action positions
protocol.weights: immutable original Level 3B cohort weights; no updates
protocol.network: inherit frozen Level 3B 32 KC→MBON05 edges, LIF/contact model, encoder and fixed readout
protocol.pass: all four admission gates pass: nonzero KC spikes, meaningful MBON response, naive baseline not action everywhere, deterministic replay
protocol.selection: choose the shortest candidate duration satisfying every admission gate; if none passes, report FAIL and identify temporal drive/integration as blocker
protocol.stop: task-free admission only; do not run learning, teaching, tuning, or any other duration; if admitted, freeze the selected duration for the next Level 4 protocol and stop

scope: task-free temporal-input admission only; no learning or DAN teaching
